entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: ¶But Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

words.text: , and let this be your consolations

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: As for me, [is] my complaint to man? and if [it were so], why should not my spirit be troubled? {troubled: Heb. shortened?}

words.text: ? and if [it were so], why should not my spirit

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay [your] hand upon [your] mouth. {Mark...: Heb. Look unto me}

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: ¶Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses [are] safe from fear, neither [is] the rod of God upon them. {safe...: Heb. peace from}

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave. {in wealth: or, in mirth}

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: What [is] the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

words.text: should we have, if we pray

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Lo, their good [is] not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: ¶How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and [how oft] cometh their destruction upon them! [God] distributeth sorrows in his anger. {candle: or, lamp}

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away. {carrieth: Heb. stealeth}

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know [it]. {his iniquity: that is, the punishment of his iniquity}

words.text: [it]. {his iniquity: that is, the punishment of his iniquity}

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what pleasure [hath] he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

words.text: is cut off in the midst

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: Shall [any] teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet. {his...: Heb. his very, or, the strength of, his perfection}

words.text: . {his...: Heb. his very, or, the strength of, his perfection}

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow. {breasts: or, milk pails}

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: ¶Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices [which] ye wrongfully imagine against me.

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For ye say, Where [is] the house of the prince? and where [are] the dwelling places of the wicked? {the dwelling...: Heb. the tent of the tabernacles}

words.text: ? {the dwelling...: Heb. the tent of the tabernacles}

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath. {wrath: Heb. wraths}

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him [what] he hath done?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb. {grave: Heb. graves} {remain...: Heb. watch in the heap}

words.text: . {grave: Heb. graves} {remain...: Heb. watch in the heap}

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as [there are] innumerable before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood? {falsehood: Heb. transgression?}
